name: Cultist: the client lets Entropic Slam be cast at 40 Insanity (#7316)
contract: Issue COA-7316: Entropic Slam (804152) drains 40 Insanity, but it could not be cast below 60. Spell.dbc (server, CoA client patch-T and Ascension live patch-T alike) gives it CasterAuraSpell 680603, the marker the server keeps on a Cultist at 60 Insanity or more (AscensionCultist.cpp: 680601/680602/680603/680604 at 20/40/60/80). AscensionCultistContracts.cpp sets the server's copy to the 40 Insanity marker 680602, but the client checks its own record first and refuses the cast without 680603. Expected: on login the server streams its Entropic Slam row with CasterAuraSpell 680602, so the client asks for 40 Insanity as the server does.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the client's Entropic Slam row asks for the 40 Insanity marker
